question.text: Let $f: R \rightarrow R$ be given by $f(x)=\left|x^{2}-1\right|, x \in R$. then

options.text: f has a local minimum at $x=\pm 1$ but no local maximum
f has a local maximum at $x=0$ but no local minimum
$\mathrm{f}$ has a local minima at $\mathrm{x}=\pm 1$ and a local maxima at $\mathrm{x}=0$
f has neither a local maxima nor a local minima at any point

solution.text: $f$ has a local minima at $x=\pm 1$ and local maximum at $x=0$
